items.name: Mid-Market Importer
items.teuLimit: Up to 1,200 TEUs or 300 Air Shipments/year
items.description: Designed for growing import teams needing real-time container tracking, carrier milestone normalization, and basic exception alerts.
features: Multi-modal tracking (Ocean container, Air AWB, Drayage)
Automated EDI 214 and 315 event normalization
Predictive arrival time estimates updated every 3 hours
Configurable exception alerts for port congestion and dwell
Standard integrations for QuickBooks Enterprise and NetSuite
Email and webhook notifications
Standard SLA with 8-hour support response

items.name: Commercial Importer
items.teuLimit: Up to 6,000 TEUs or 1,500 Air Shipments/year
items.description: Ideal for mid-size manufacturers, distributors, and retailers requiring automated landed cost calculation, ERP synchronization, and demurrage mitigation.
features: All Mid-Market capabilities included
Full AIS satellite vessel telemetry refreshed hourly
Automated Landed Cost calculator with customs tariff breakdowns
Demurrage and detention risk countdown ledger
Native two-way ERP integrations (SAP S/4HANA, Dynamics 365, NetSuite)
Role-based access control with unlimited viewers
Customs hold early-warning flags (FDA, USDA, CBP)
Priority 2-hour technical support response

items.name: Global Enterprise
items.description: For high-volume multi-facility importers needing dedicated EDI forwarding pipelines, custom TMS orchestration, and comprehensive IT governance.
features: All Commercial Importer capabilities included
Dedicated cloud tenant isolation options
Custom ERP and TMS connector engineering (CargoWise, Blue Yonder)
Automated carrier contract SLA compliance auditing
Single Sign-On (SAML 2.0 / Okta / Azure AD)
Custom API rate limit allotments and private webhooks
Dedicated enterprise solutions architect and quarterly business reviews
Guaranteed 99.95% uptime SLA with 15-minute emergency response
